en-US.title: Service Desk & SLA Center
en-US.summary: Operational center for tracking volume, priority, SLA, backlog and recurring requests.
en-US.problem: Requests arrived through scattered channels, making prioritization, due-date tracking and recurring-issue analysis difficult.
en-US.role: Process mapping, Notion data structure, service categories, indicators and analytical experience design.
en-US.solution: A single operational workflow with traceability and a recreated HTML dashboard using fictional tickets, people and business units.
results: Interactive demo with priority and category filters
SLA, backlog, volume and recurrence views
Structure prepared for weekly operational reviews
